summary: When launching a new enterprise, **founders often find themselves trapped in the daily grind**, personally handling every single task required to keep operations afloat. To break this exhausting cycle, entrepreneurs must recognize the exact moment when **delegation becomes essential**, which typically happens when they can no longer dedicate at least a quarter of their working hours to high-level strategy and expansion. While some owners choose to remain the central bottleneck of their operations to hoard control, those who aspire to scale efficiently can **leverage international talent pools** to cut overhead costs and build sustainable organizations.
